# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering reliability and platform alignment**

## Highlights

Upcoming 4.156.0 changes improve native callback correctness and modernize Uno integration. Android texture rendering follows the display clock, Linux HarfBuzz avoids conflicting system-library calls, and WebAssembly linking no longer compiles WebGPU C++ support inside applications. Apple deployment requirements rise, and Uno consumers should review the .NET 10 baseline and raster fallback.

## Breaking Changes

- **Higher Apple deployment requirements** — Native SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp require macOS 11 or iOS/tvOS/Mac Catalyst 14. Managed iOS and tvOS minimums rise to 14; managed macOS 12 and Mac Catalyst 15 minimums remain higher. Update application deployment targets to satisfy both native and managed requirements. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
- **Uno views move to Uno Platform 7 and .NET 10** — The non-Windows Uno views assembly now requires .NET 10 and Uno Platform 7. Upgrade Uno dependencies and replace obsolete per-platform runtime packages with the common implementation; Uno.Sdk supplies platform native assets. Windows targets remain facades over SkiaSharp.Views.WinUI. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Uno SKSwapChainPanel uses a raster fallback** — On non-Windows Uno targets, SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid, returns null GRContext and paints a raster surface; its reported backend target has framebuffer zero. RaiseOnUnsupported is removed and DrawInBackground remains unsupported. Use SKCanvasElement when GPU rendering is required. The WinAppSDK control remains ANGLE-backed. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Legacy Uno WasmShell linking is retired** — Pre-Uno 7 WasmShell native-asset targets are removed. Move WebAssembly applications to Uno 7's .NET SDK integration instead of the former Uno.Wasm.Bootstrap emcc pipeline. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **SKData.CreateCopy rejects oversized array lengths** — SKData.CreateCopy(byte[], ulong) now throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the requested length exceeds the source array. Pass a length within the array instead of relying on an out-of-bounds native read. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))

## Engine

- **Skia m156 compiler and GLES fixes** — Rejects overflowing Raster Pipeline slot counts and invalid runtime-effect types earlier in SkSL compilation. Ganesh GL also stops advertising an invalid BGRA8-as-RGBx upload configuration in GLES; readback is unchanged. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native callback boolean widths** — Corrects Skia callbacks to use one-byte native booleans and HarfBuzz callbacks to use four-byte hb_bool_t values, including false-return handling. This addresses Apple ARM64 interpreter callback behavior while preserving public managed bool signatures. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))
- **Display-paced Android rendering** — Automatic texture-backed frames, including MAUI SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, follow Choreographer display callbacks instead of buffer-swap throughput. Drawing stays on the GL worker; explicit render requests remain independent and pause, resize and reattachment continue to make progress. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Linux HarfBuzz load-order isolation** — Binds internal bundled HarfBuzz function calls locally, preventing system HarfBuzz loaded by GTK from intercepting calls and mixing incompatible private objects. Applies to the common Linux recipe, including NoDependencies builds; exported entry points are unchanged. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **WebAssembly WebGPU linking** — Ships emdawnwebgpu C++ support inside libSkiaSharp.a so application C sources no longer receive incompatible C++ flags. JavaScript glue remains a link input rather than deployed content. Newer consumers need rebuilt, GPU-enabled archives; the .NET 8 built-in path remains. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Unicode conversion and native string copying** — Corrects StringUtilities character-code decoding for single encoded units and rejects multi-unit inputs; use UTF-32 for supplementary characters. Null byte arrays now raise ArgumentNullException in GetString. FromCString also fixes a native buffer over-read. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506), [#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Release borrowed stream references** — Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream now releases its managed reference to the wrapped stream even when disposeUnderlyingStream is false. It does not dispose that borrowed stream; the caller retains disposal responsibility. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Fewer temporary copy and encoding allocations** — Managed image pixel copies avoid an intermediate SKData allocation for valid direct-copy inputs. HarfBuzzSharp AddUtf32 string calls avoid a fresh encoded byte array, and feature-string formatting avoids native allocation while preserving existing decoding behavior. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **Windows rendering dependencies refreshed** — Updates ANGLE to chromium/8118 and aligns the Windows library dependency baseline with Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003 for MAUI 9 and 10 integration. Public APIs and the WinUI Windows 10 build 17763 minimum are unchanged. ([#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321), [#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390))
